# rapttor/yii2-postar

Yii2 client for the live Postar API (POST https://api.postar.vip/v1/send, Bearer pk_ key; guide https://postar.vip/llm.txt). Namespace rapttor\postar\. Plain curl, no SDK.

SETUP = environment only: POSTAR_API_KEY (+ POSTAR_FROM, POSTAR_FROM_NAME, POSTAR_REPLY_TO, optional POSTAR_BASE_URL). When POSTAR_API_KEY is present the package Bootstrap registers the `postar` component and replaces Yii::$app->mailer with yii\symfonymailer\Mailer + PostarTransport. NO MAIL_DSN, no postar:// DSN, no component or mailer config. Never configure Postar through MAIL_DSN. No key = nothing changes (Mailpit etc. stay).
Classes: Postar (component), PostarTransport (AbstractTransport, one API call per recipient), SendApi (curl client, injectable http callable for tests), EmailQueue, QueueTransport, PostarApiException (->isSuppressed(), ->resubscribeUrl()).
Rules: Postar adds the unsubscribe link (footer + List-Unsubscribe) to every mail itself: the plugin never sends an unsubscribe field or link;
a suppressed recipient (HTTP 422 bounce/complaint/unsubscribe) is skipped, logged and exposed via PostarTransport::$suppressed / $onSuppressed (never an exception, never retry);
other API errors -> TransportException. ATTACHMENTS: the Postar API (llm.txt) has no attachment field yet; policy POSTAR_ATTACHMENTS (or Postar::$attachments) = send (posts `attachments`: [{filename, content_type, content(base64), inline?, cid?}], needs the service to accept it, see docs/ATTACHMENTS.md) | skip-inline (default: embedded cid images dropped with a warning, real attachments throw) | skip | throw. Prefer absolute image URLs over cid: logos. The From domain must be allowed for the key (@postar.vip needs no DNS). postar.vip addresses cannot receive replies: set POSTAR_REPLY_TO.

Direct use: Yii::$app->postar->send($to, $subject, $html, ['text'=>..]) (component auto-registered; declare it only to override settings).
Yii::$app->postar->send($to, $subject, $html, ['text'=>..]) -> ['id','status']; unsubscribe($email) / isUnsubscribed($email) / unsubscribeStatus($email) / resubscribe($email) map to /v1/unsubscribes.
PostarApiException: errorCode() (recipient_unsubscribed|recipient_suppressed), resubscribeUrl(), isSuppressed(). Postar adds the unsubscribe link itself: never add your own.
Postar::$defaultMailer: null (auto: on when a key is present) | false opts out of the mailer takeover | true forces it. Replaces an existing mailer definition.

Queue: POSTAR_QUEUE=1 (or Postar::$queue=true) stores mails in table rapttor_emailqueue (run `php yii migrate`; Bootstrap registers rapttor\postar\migrations). Cron: `php yii postar/run` every minute (`php yii postar/cron --install` adds it). Other commands: postar/stats, postar/retry-failed, postar/purge [days]. Or Yii::$app->postar->queue()->enqueue([to, from, subject, html, text, name, reply_to]).
Worker rules: 429 pauses the run, 5xx/network retried with backoff (maxAttempts), blocked recipient -> status suppressed (never retried), other 4xx -> failed.
LOCAL ENVS: auto mode does NOT replace the mailer when YII_ENV is dev or test (Mailpit keeps working). Override: 'enabled' => true|false, POSTAR_ENABLED=1|0, 'localEnvs' => [...]. Never force-enable Postar in a dev config that should keep using Mailpit.

Sender is optional everywhere: from/fromName/replyTo config or POSTAR_FROM/POSTAR_FROM_NAME/POSTAR_REPLY_TO; else from = <slug of Yii::$app->name>@postar.vip and name = Yii::$app->name. Per mail: send(..., ['from','name','reply_to']), queue()->enqueue([... optional from,name,reply_to]). Set replyTo: postar.vip addresses cannot receive replies.
